correctness.rationale: For K_{a,n} with a=n+floor(lambda*n/log n), the independent exponential threshold construction reproduces infection rates (a-i)j and (n-j)i. The uniform exposure empirical bounds and total hazard lower bound yield completion time O_p(log n/n). The exposure difference H_B-H_A is o_p(1) at log log n and accumulates the imbalance lambda across the terminal log n/n time window, while susceptible-time integrals vanish. Independent Gumbel maxima then give a logistic difference and P(last class A)->e^lambda/(1+e^lambda). For a=n, after the forced first B infection, the (1,1) state enjoys part-swap symmetry, implying exactly 1/2. Independent 121 exact rational finite biclique recursions confirm finite transitions, not the limit.
